name: Vulcanic
tagline: A RUMBLE journal — one earthbender's climb, logged hour by hour
description: Vulcanic's RUMBLE VR journal: blog posts stamped with hours played and battle points, a progress tracker, and a collection of sayings on the art of the arena.
intro: I'm **Vulcanic**. This is where I write about RUMBLE, the VR earthbending fighter, as I climb. Every post is stamped with where I was at the time: hours in, battle points, and my PORC rank. Read the [tracker](tracker/) to see the whole arc, or the [tips](tips/) if you want the short version.
